name: Customizable antenna holder for Turnigy 9x Flysky.stl

captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a three-piece modular clamp system designed to sandwich around a cylindrical handle and antenna base. The set includes two thicker blocks with large semi-cylindrical cutouts along their top faces to cradle a cylindrical object, and one thinner flat block with a small transverse semi-cylindrical groove on its bottom face. Each of the three rectangular blocks features four matching vertical screw holes near their corners, allowing them to be aligned and bolted together securely.
captions.instruction: Design a 3D-printable modular antenna mount for a Turnigy 9X transmitter handle, consisting of three parametric clamp pieces (front, middle, and back). The script should define adjustable parameters for the antenna base diameter, the thickness of the front/back pieces, and the thickness of the middle piece, ensuring the screw holes automatically adjust their positions to avoid overlapping with the central cylindrical cutouts.
captions.factory: The OpenSCAD script generates three separate rectangular blocks using the cube primitive, each processed using difference operations. The front and middle pieces feature a large horizontal cylinder cutout for the antenna base, while the middle and back pieces feature smaller perpendicular cylinder cutouts to fit the transmitter handle. All three pieces share a common four-hole mounting pattern generated using translated cylinders, with their spacing dynamically calculated relative to the antenna diameter parameter to prevent overlap.
